behavior: A Navigation Menu popup takes its accessible name from its trigger: `aria-labelledby` has the id of the active trigger, and each trigger has an id. Each open popup is thus a navigation landmark with a name of its own, also in a nested menu. The popup keeps the name until it unmounts. When the consumer gives the popup an `aria-label` or an `aria-labelledby`, the popup takes the name of the consumer. Base UI gives the popup no name. Thus two open popups, or one popup beside a root with no name, are two navigation landmarks with no name.
